citations.quote: Alle seien gesund, es gehe ihr um die Wohnung.
Nebenbei erwähnt sie, dass an den Wänden Kondenswasser herunterläuft und die Fensterrahmen schimmlig sind.

Laut Frau Ammann muss deshalb ein Heizungsfachmann die Ursache abklären, wenn man da weiterkommen will.

questions: When were the defects first reported to the landlord, and is there a written report or proof of receipt?
Are the heating failures ongoing, and is there any immediate safety concern?
Has a specialist inspected the installation, and are a report or dated temperature and moisture observations available?
What repairs or access arrangements has the landlord proposed?
